_note: All 14 services below, including fee/processingTime/office, are from the Municipal Government of Aborlan Citizen's Charter 2025 (1st revision), pulled directly from aborlanpalawan.gov.ph's own PDF and cross-checked against the 'TOTAL' row of each service's step table. Seedling/farm-input distribution and a local scholarship program were removed from this list — neither is listed as a frontline service in the Charter, so rather than leave a stub with fabricated fields, they're left out until a real source (LGU Agriculture/Education office) confirms one exists and how to avail it. Where a service has multiple sub-processes (e.g. Senior Citizen ID also covers purchase booklets and financial assistance), only the primary/first one's figures are used here.

services.title: Birth Certificate
services.description: Request a copy of a birth certificate (local civil registry or PSA copy).

services.title: Marriage Certificate
services.description: Request a copy of a marriage certificate.
services.processingTime: Same-day for on-time registration; up to 11 days for delayed registration (includes a mandatory 10-day posting period)

services.title: Death Certificate
services.description: Request a copy of a death certificate.

services.title: Business Permit (New)
services.description: Apply for a new mayor's permit for a business operating in Aborlan.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code (Municipal Tax Ordinance No. 01, s. 2018) — varies by business type and gross receipts
services.office: Office of the Municipal Mayor – Business Permit and Licensing Division (BPLO)

services.title: Business Permit Renewal
services.description: Renew an existing annual business permit. Must be renewed January 1–20 each year per the local tax ordinance; penalties apply after.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code (Municipal Tax Ordinance No. 01, s. 2018) — varies by business type and gross receipts
services.office: Office of the Municipal Mayor – Business Permit and Licensing Division (BPLO)

services.title: Real Property Tax
services.description: Pay annual real property tax on land and improvements.
services.fee: 2% of assessed value (10% discount for prompt payment, 20% for advance payment; 2% monthly penalty on late payment)

services.title: Cedula (Community Tax Certificate)
services.description: Community tax certificate for individuals and businesses.
services.fee: Individual: ₱5.00 basic + variable (based on income/business/property); Corporation: ₱500.00 basic + variable

services.title: Senior Citizen ID
services.description: ID for residents 60 years old and above.
services.office: MSWDO – Office for the Senior Citizen Affairs (OSCA)

services.title: PWD ID
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)

services.title: Medical / Financial Assistance
services.description: Emergency financial aid for medical, burial, or educational needs. For indigent residents who have not yet availed of financial assistance during the year.
services.office: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO)

services.title: Medical Consultation
services.description: Consultation at Rural Health Units / Municipal Health Office.

services.title: Building Permit
services.description: Permit for new construction or renovation.
services.fee: Based on the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) — varies by project
services.processingTime: 1 hour 20 minutes (office processing after all required endorsements are secured)

services.title: Disaster Preparedness & Response
services.description: MDRRMO emergency response, evacuation, and disaster-readiness programs. Requests can be sent to aborlandrrmoffice@gmail.com.
services.office: Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO)

services.title: Waste Collection Schedule
services.description: Garbage collection schedule and waste segregation guidelines by barangay, per Municipal Ordinance No. 17, s. 2009.
services.office: Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office (MENRO)
